name: Barcodes
provides_field_formatters: barcode (email, integer, link, string, telephone, text, text_long, text_with_summary, bigint, uuid)
provides_theme_hooks: barcode__{type} (one per barcode type, e.g. barcode__qrcode, barcode__c128)
ecosystem_note: A display/output module wrapping the tecnickcom/tc-lib-barcode PHP library. It exposes barcode rendering four ways over the SAME generator: (1) a 'barcode' FIELD FORMATTER for text-ish field types, (2) a 'barcode' BLOCK plugin with a free-text (token-aware) value, (3) a 'barcode' TWIG FILTER for arbitrary strings in templates, and (4) two DRUSH commands (barcodes:generate, barcodes:formats). All four accept the same knobs: type (40+ symbologies incl. QRCODE, C128, EAN13, DATAMATRIX, PDF417, AZTEC), format (SVG default in code / config, plus PNG data-URI, HTMLDIV, UNICODE, BINARY grid), color, width, height, and four paddings, plus a show_value toggle. Output is produced by Com\Tecnick\Barcode\Barcode::getBarcodeObj() and emitted as getSvgCode(), a base64 PNG , getHtmlDiv(), or an ASCII/unicode grid. Values are run through the Token service before encoding (field/block use entity-context tokens). Ships NO permissions and NO config entities; formatter/block settings are stored on the view-display / block config. Defines ~40 theme hooks (barcode + barcode__{type}) and a matching per-type CSS library, but the templates are near-identical thin wrappers that print the pre-rendered barcode markup.
